cohort: 500 pregnant patients admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology between August 2018 and July 2019, with 300 booked (>= 3 antenatal visits) and 200 unbooked (< 3 antenatal visits).
finding: Unbooked patients experienced higher rates of DIC, vaginal, cervical, and perineal tears, cesarean hysterectomy, and postpartum complications compared to booked patients.
